newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rica to host ACPC meet alongside Sintercafe.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica to host ACPC meet alongside Sintercafe.

text.p: The Association of Coffee Producing Countries (ACPC) will hold a technical group meeting in Costa Rica next month that coincides with the country's annual International Coffee Week.

ACPC members, including representatives from coffee giants Brazil and Colombia, are to take advantage of the Costa Rican coffee gathering, known in the trade as the world "coffee party" to analyze markets and the export quota scheme.

"It is a meeting of the technical group of the ACPC and market perspectives and results of the export limit programme will be discussed," Guillmero Canet, the executive director of the Costa Rica Coffee Institute told Reuters.
The International Coffee Week, known as Sintercafe in Spanish, runs from Nov 9 to 13, and ACPC technical group nations will meet for the first two days of the period.
"We believe that the moment is right to analyse the results of the mechanisms in place to regulate (coffee) supplies between July 1996 and June 1997," Canet added.
Along with Brazil and Colombia, other nations to attend the technical meeting are Ivory Coast, El Salvador, Indonesia and Uganda.
